name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a junior gold exploration company that acquires and explores mineral properties and royalty interests primarily in Nevada and Idaho. The company's flagship Lapon Canyon Project is located within the Walker Lane gold trend in Nevada, where it holds a 50% earn-in interest and a 3% net smelter royalty. The company is advancing toward its first NI 43-101 compliant resource estimate following airborne geophysical surveys and recent drill programs.
